source_reviews.publisher: John Bollinger, Technical Analysis of Stocks and Commodities, February 1992
source_reviews.reviewed: all five scanned PDF pages rendered and visually read, including formula/chart captions and spreadsheet sidebar
source_reviews.finding: Figure 4 divides variance by N; the spreadsheet sidebar explicitly uses population deviation and typical price. The main discussion also permits closes. This is not the current sample-deviation recross. A second extreme inside the band after an outside extreme, with appropriate confirmation, is a distinct pattern from one-bar recross. Historical period/width suggestions differ from the current 22-rule page, so source versions must stay explicit.

source_reviews.publisher: FX Trader Magazine interview with John Bollinger, April-June 2014
source_reviews.reviewed: all four scanned pages, printed pages 47-50, rendered and visually read
source_reviews.finding: The author separates band-relative position, momentum, bandwidth history and trend tools; complementary confirmation and practice matter. He identifies a limitation for volume-dependent accumulation tools in forex and emphasizes position sizing and learning from repeated practice. The interview does not publish a complete guaranteed intraday system or every indicator formula.
